notes.title: Introducing Sandbox Mode!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We've been working hard on fixing bugs, improving balancing, and adding an exciting new way to play: Sandbox Mode! Here's a few details on what to expect in our latest update:

[h2][b]Sandbox Mode[/b][/h2]
[b]Sandbox mode can be accessed through the main menu. This mode is completely separate from the usual Career and differs from it in multiple ways. Some of the main differences between the two are:[/b]
-You start Sandbox mode at maximum level with a large amount of money.
-The Workshop is fully unlocked from the start and all of the locations are accessible (although conditions still apply, such as the specific days for auctions).
-Achievements cannot be unlocked in Sandbox mode.

[h2][b]QoL Updates[/b][/h2]
-Jobs missing parts can now be cancelled once 7 days have passed after the deadline
-While dismantling a device, you can now see missing parts that are not in your inventory as unnamed silhouettes in the quick inventory
-Parts can now be marked in a notebook from the “Device Parts List” UI screen by clicking them. This will mark them in both the Item Shop and in Stashes found in external locations

[h2][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h2]
-Rent penalty has been removed and rent cannot put you with a negative balance anymore
-The value of washing, sandblasting and painting parts of devices you restore for resale has been increased
-The value of completing secondary objectives you get from orders has been increased

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
-While looking at the parts list for a device, parts installed onto other parts were not shown in the list at all if the part they were installed on was missing (e.g. if the Oil Tank was missing in the Oil Lamp, the Wick Tunnel would not appear in the list of parts at all, this is no longer the case)
-Fixed an issue with the timer for buying Storage Units not pausing while the game is paused.
-Fixed an issue with boxes in Storage Units being left flying if the box underneath them was opened first.
-Fixed an issue with the price of parts not updating in the Item Shop Cart if the amount was changed using a controller.
-Fixed an issue with the tutorial prompt for the Washing Prompt not being displayed when required.
-Fixed an issue with the Calendar loading the wrong days for a given month.
-Fixed an issue where the Deadline for a Job would appear to skip a day under certain conditions.

Thank you everyone for your support and for leaving us a review. We hope you enjoy the latest version, and if you have any suggestions please let us know.

Thank you all for playing The Repair House

Quantum Logic Games

notes.title: Patch 4 04.10.23
notes.content:
The new patch includes a fix to a previous issue with save files. To rectify this issue we have had to change the location where The Repair House save files are stored on your computer.

To continue playing with the progress you have already made in The Repair House, you will need to move your existing save game file to the new location.

[b]To replace the new save file with your existing one. Follow the steps below.[/b]
[list]
[*] Update the game with the latest patch
[*] Launch the game
[*] Allow the game to load into the main menu
[*] Press the “Windows” key to view your computer's desktop
[*] Open the Windows File Explorer (shortcut is Windows Key + E)
[*] Go to the below location on your local hard drive [i](bold items in the address will the specific to your computer)[/i]
[*] C:\Users\[b]WINDOWS USERNAME[/b]\AppData\LocalLow\Quantum Logic Games\The Repair House
[*] From this folder, copy the savegame.dat file
[*] Open the folder named with 17 digits. This folder name will be unique to your computer. For example: “77531899330858648” - If this folder does not currently exist, return to The Repair House, start a new game and then return to The Repair House main menu.
[*] Paste the original savegame.dat file into this folder
[*] Select the option to “replace the file in the destination”
[*] You should now be able to return to The Repair House and continue with your previous save file and progress
[/list]

If you have any issues with the above instructions please submit a ticket via our [url=https://fireshinegames.co.uk/submit-a-support-ticket/]customer support portal[/url] and we will do our best to assist you.


Other fixes in this patch:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that made the buttons used to cycle through current orders at the Catalogue table hard to click.
[*] Fixed an issue with the 3D models of one of the Popcorn Machine's top covers.
[*] The calendar now resets to the current month each time you view it.
[/list]



Thank you all for playing The Repair House

[b]Quantum Logic Games[/b]

notes.title: Patch 3 Notes 04.09.23
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay Balancing Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Replaced default "Arcade Hockey Table" device from Storage Lot with "Ice Zone Air Hockey Table".
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Only paintable, washable and sandblastable parts appear in their respective tool inventory.
[*] You can now cycle through all accepted orders when using the "Job Details" button while in the Catalogue Table.
[*] You can now sort your Inventory by item condition, alphabetically or by latest acquired.
[*] Removed camera snapback when working at large devices.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with a pop-up remaining on screen while trying to unpack a large device from the delivery box if you had no space to unpack that device.
[*] Fixed a bug with the continue button in the main menu that made it unclickable in some instances.
[*] Fixed a bug with "Table I" decoration that made it unable to rotate.
[*] Fixed a bug with the small display case that allowed you to go through the roof of the workshop.
[*] Fixed a bug with the ceiling and wall paints that made it so the wall paint was used instead of the ceiling paint.
[*] Fixed a bug that made you unable to use wall and ceiling paints with the controller.
[*] Fixed a visual issue with the "Boombox" device.
[*] Fixed some collider issues inside Barn 1.
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing Space during loading screen started a new game, overwriting player's progress.
[*] Fixed some collider issues inside Barn 2.
[*] Fixed decorating mode bug where you could get stuck in walls.
[*] Fixed "Forge Blower" device bug that appeared at orders.
[*] Fixed "Tough Love" achievement bug where players could not unlock the achievement.
[*] Replaced default "Arcade Hockey Table" device from Storage Lot with "Ice Zone Air Hockey Table".
[*] Fixed a bug where players could not remap the "E" button.
[*] Fixed "Claw Machine" device visual bug.
[*] Fixed cursor bug caused by Washing Station.
[*] Fixed bugs at Washing Station, Sandblasting Station and Paint Table where devices and components would change color after changing scenes.
[*] Fixed "Tinker Tank" device visual bug.
[*] Fixed "Popcorn Machine" device visual bug.
[*] Fixed "Juno Guitar" device, "Titania Guitar" device, "Saturn Guitar" device visual bug.
[*] Fixed "Tinker Bulldozer" device visual bug.
[*] Fixed a bug at Washing Station where you couldn't use the radial menu.
[*] Fixed a bug in Decorating Mode where the Washing Station could push player through walls;
[*] Fixed shop stairs visual bug.
[*] Fixed "RC Buggy" device visual bug.
[*] Fixed a bug where the calendar would not reset to the current month when the player interacts with it.
[*] Lowered Washing Station sound effect volume.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2 Notes 03.08.23
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay Balancing Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Further reduced the price of sandblasting and painting.
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now see the device parts list for order devices as well, not only for devices you own, by pressing the More Info button while viewing the job details on the device.
[*] Added the search bar to the Washing Station inventory.
[*] Orders where you need to repaint parts are now clearer.
[*] Made the install order on the Dayton Train and the Vintage Turntable more straightforward.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with the installed positions of some components on the Arcade Basketball, Dayton Train, RC Buggy and Tinker Delivery Truck.
[*] Fixed a bug with canceling jobs on the Sandblaster.
[*] Fixed a bug that required the Skateboard to be washed, painted and sandblasted on the grip surface as well.
[*] Fixed an issue with painting on the RC Buggy Wheels.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Tinker Bulldozer Blade II being unpaintable.
[*] Fixed an issue with recycling items in the inventory while searching for items at the same time.
[*] Fixed some text display issues.
[*] Fixed some visual bugs on various devices.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1 Notes 24.07.23
notes.content:
[h1]Gameplay Balancing Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced price of washing, painting and sandblasting.
[*] Sale prices for devices bought in external locations should now better reflect the price of the repairs they require and their overall condition.
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to see the full device details while the device is in the delivery box.
[*] Walking speed has been increased.
[*] Main inventory now shows all the categories, including all of the ones that pertain to decorations.
[*] The item shop is now sorted alphabetically.
[*] The Flea Market now has more items as you reach higher levels.
[*] Added support for more common screen resolutions
[*] Improvements made to tool controls
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where keybind prompts are not saved after remapping in some instances.
[*] Fixed an issue where the list of device parts was cut off at the bottom.
[*] Camera zoom level no longer resets after installing or uninstalling a part.
[*] The shelf is now placed lower for easier access when starting a new game.
[*] Fixed an issue with some parts that made them invisible at the Paint Table.
[*] Removed the hammer icon appearing underneath items in the inventory as it was no longer needed.
[*] Fixed an issue with offers not updating when devices are placed in Display Cases.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Tobacco Grinder Inlet could not be installed back.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Device More Info UI showed the text "Current Offer" instead of "Price" or "Value."
[/list]
